summary: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed four Hamas operatives, including a Nukhba force member and an October 7 attacker, with the IDF citing systematic ceasefire violations. The Saudi-led coalition intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Khamis Mushait, while European diplomats were assaulted by masked Israeli settlers near Taybeh in the West Bank. Simultaneously, artillery shelling struck southern Lebanese villages and explosions hit IRGC-linked sites in Baghdad and the Strait of Hormuz.
key_points: IDF confirms four Hamas operatives killed in Gaza strikes, including Nukhba member and October 7 participant, citing ceasefire violations. (Source: @manniefabian/59366)
Saudi-led coalition intercepts two Houthi ballistic missiles fired toward Khamis Mushait in southern Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/230458)
European diplomats attacked by masked Israeli settlers near Taybeh, West Bank; French mayor injured, Belgian vehicle damaged. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8483)
Artillery shelling and explosions reported in southern Lebanon at Zoutar Al-Sharqiya, Wadi Al-Salouqi, and Kounin-Beit Yahoun. (Source: @redlinkleb/48318)
Iraqi PM orders investigation into ammunition cache explosion at IRGC-backed PMU site in eastern Baghdad; no casualties reported. (Source: @shin_persian/11223)
Blasts heard in Strait of Hormuz near Iran; UKMTO issues maritime warning 175-26 for the area. (Source: @shin_persian/11209)
US BE20 King Air surveillance aircraft conducts visual/electronic intelligence mission over Lebanon at 3,925 feet. (Source: @redlinkleb/48303)
Trump states Israel assisting Saudis, reopening possibility of Saudi accession to Abraham Accords. (Source: @amitsegal/65873)

Four Hamas operatives eliminated in Gaza strikes including Nukhba force member Mahmoud Khaled Mohammed Madhoun who conducted anti-tank missile attacks on troops, sniper Ubaida Suhail Hamad Murtaja, October 7 invader Adham Khalil Mohammed Marouf, and Abd al-Jawad Juda. (Source: @manniefabian/59366)

French, Belgian, Polish diplomats and Catholic representatives attacked by masked Israeli settlers near Taybeh village in Binyamin region; French mayor injured, Belgian consulate vehicle window smashed; Israeli police investigating. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8483)

Netanyahu states delegation included hostile figures entering sensitive area without coordination; no documentation substantiates Jewish violence against them. (Source: @amitsegal/65878)

Explosion carried out by enemy army in vicinity of Kounin and Beit Yahoun villages in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/48312)

Warplanes observed heading south per live map; US BE20 King Air surveillance aircraft (AE130F, reg 73-1216) conducts visual/electronic intelligence mission over Lebanon at 3,925 feet. (Source: @redlinkleb/48336)

Explosion and smoke plumes observed near Sabaa Abkar area in Baghdad; second similar report confirms incident at same location. (Source: @shin_persian/11218)
Explosion heard in Soran, Erbil Province, Iraq; cause and attribution unspecified. (Source: @shin_persian/11224)
Saudi-led coalition intercepts two ballistic missiles launched by Houthis toward Khamis Mushait in southern Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/230458)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Hamas operative eliminations in Gaza, Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Arabia, diplomat assaults in West Bank, and artillery exchanges in Lebanon indicate a multi-front escalation pattern. Iranian-backed militia ammunition explosions in Baghdad and Strait of Hormuz blasts suggest covert maritime and land instability. US surveillance over Lebanon and Israeli political friction over settler violence complicate de-escalation efforts across theaters.
sections.regional_response: Saudi-led coalition actively intercepts Houthi missiles while Trump signals diplomatic opening for Saudi Abraham Accords entry. Iraqi PM orders investigation into IRGC-linked explosion, showing Baghdad's attempt to manage militia accountability. European diplomatic corps demands accountability for West Bank attack, with Rubio expressing concern. Israeli leadership disputes settler violence evidence despite IDF confirmation of Jewish rioters.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Zoutar Al-Sharqiya and Wadi Al-Salouqi shelling correlates with warplane movements south, suggesting coordinated air-ground operations. US BE20 King Air surveillance at 3,925 feet over Lebanon indicates persistent ISR focus on southern border. Iranian Mi-171E refueling in Fars Province and Strait of Hormuz blasts may signal naval militia activity or accidents. Hamas Nukhba targeting shows Israeli intelligence penetration despite ceasefire.
